benchmark: video k-NN accuracy + backend agreement (UCF101 subset)

dataset.frame_sampling: idx = round(linspace(0, T_total-1, 16)) over all PyAV rgb24 frames

protocol.feature: mean over encoder tokens (pooled_mean), L2-normalized — except levjepa-vitl16, which is read through its CLS token (pooler_output), also L2-normalized
protocol.centroid: nearest L2-normalized class mean of the gallery
